status: optional research leads; not acceptance or architecture

questions.question: How do acquisition tails and false admissions behave under the task’s actual noise and signal-present definition?
questions.seed_basis: F1 / S1 https://doi.org/10.1109/TIT.1974.1055282 and S4 https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/622965; unresolved receiver-specific threshold and calibration
questions.decision_use: Which validation outcomes matter when judging the proposed deadline.

questions.question: Does time variation in the actual signal make the stationary-tone evidence a poor guide to the next comparison?
questions.seed_basis: F4 / S5 https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/3515/; abstract-only multiplicative-noise model may not match oscillator drift or envelope
questions.decision_use: Whether to prioritize stationary versus time-varying conditions in the next investigation.

questions.question: Is phase continuity preserved across delivery and capture resets, and how does that affect the range and delay tradeoff?
questions.seed_basis: F3 / S3 https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/1605457; unresolved actual capture continuity
questions.decision_use: Whether the delay comparison is applicable.

limitations: Original labels S1–S5 peer-reviewed; the verifier established journal metadata, not peer-review status. Original S1 access was abstract/metadata; a verifier separately accessed a mirror. S3/S4 opens failed; S5 is abstract-only. No paper establishes the receiver target.
